That personal touch is what people write about. One customer said Mr. Ricky and his team are truly exceptional and that the quality of their craftsmanship is unmatched. about.h2: About Richard Cleghorn and the shop
about.text: Cleghorn Cabinets is a cabinet shop at 108 Constitution Dr in Warner Robins, Georgia. A Georgia state business directory lists Richard Cleghorn as CEO, with the same address and phone number the shop uses today. Customers call him Mr. Cleghorn, and one review praises Mr. Ricky and his team for craftsmanship she called unmatched. The shop's Facebook page shows kitchen cabinet work, including cream glazed cabinets with glass-front uppers. If you want to talk about cabinets with the person who runs the shop, call (478) 953-6996.

steps.title: Call the shop
steps.text: Call (478) 953-6996 or email clegcabs@aol.com and describe the room, the cabinets you have in mind and when you hope to start.

steps.title: Measure and plan
steps.text: Go over measurements, layout and the look you want, such as the door style, finish color and any glass-front cabinets.

steps.title: Confirm the details
steps.text: Agree on the design, finish and pricing before work begins, so you know exactly what the shop is building for you.

steps.title: Build and install
steps.text: The shop builds your cabinets. Ask the Cleghorns how installation and scheduling work for your kitchen when you plan the job.

items.q: Who will I be working with?
items.a: Richard Cleghorn is listed as the company's CEO in a Georgia state business directory, and customers mention Mr. Cleghorn and Mr. Ricky by name in their reviews. One wrote that Mr Cleghorn was more than happy to assist and highly recommended his cabinet shop.

The shop is at 108 Constitution Dr, Warner Robins, GA 31088. Google currently shows the business as open 24 hours, which is unlikely for a cabinet shop, so call (478) 953-6996 before you drive over to make sure someone is there.

items.q: How is a cabinet job priced?
items.a: Call or email with your kitchen measurements, a rough layout and a few photos of the room. Prices depend on size, finish and the cabinet details you choose. Estimate terms are not published, so ask how pricing works when you first get in touch.
